```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## Underground Atlanta Soundscapes

Comparing project lengths and track counts across prominent releases from **Lil Tony Official**, **Pradabagshawty**, and **Glokk40Spaz**.

```{r}
#| label: album-data
albums <- tibble(
  artist = c(
    rep("Lil Tony Official", 4),
    rep("Pradabagshawty", 4),
    rep("Glokk40Spaz", 4)
  ),
  album = c(
    "TKEY (2023)", "2 Sides 2 Every Story (2023)", "14 Steps to Success (2024)", "Born Again (2025)",
    "Bloxk Addiktion (2023)", "Forever and After (2024)", "Home Invasions (2025)", "Red Flags & Roses (2025)",
    "Baby Whoa (2022)", "Don't Get Took Off 3 (2022)", "Took The Biggest Risk (2023)", "Da Real Oso (2024)"
  ),
  tracks = c(
    15, 20, 14, 16,
    12, 14, 13, 15,
    9, 14, 14, 18
  ),
  runtime = c(
    32, 51, 33, 41,
    26, 31, 28, 34,
    22, 34, 31, 44
  )
) |>
  mutate(avg_track_len = round(runtime / tracks, 2))
```

```{r}
#| label: album-plot
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(albums, aes(x = tracks, y = runtime, color = artist)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = avg_track_len), alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = album), vjust = -1, size = 3.2, check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Lil Tony Official" = "#E63946",
    "Pradabagshawty" = "#457B9D",
    "Glokk40Spaz" = "#2A9D8F"
  )) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 9), name = "Avg Track (min)") +
  labs(
    title = "Album Scope & Density Comparison",
    subtitle = "Comparing track counts, total runtimes, and average song duration",
    x = "Number of Tracks",
    y = "Total Runtime (minutes)",
    color = "Artist",
    caption = "Data compiled from streaming releases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
